hero.eyebrow: Egyptian export, direct from the source
hero.title:
From the Nile's soil,
to the world's table
hero.lead: We grow, harvest and export fresh fruit and vegetables from the Nile Delta — packed to European import standards, with full traceability from field to port.
slides: Green fields stretching across the Nile Delta at sunrise
A farmer's hands picking ripe tomatoes in the field
Sorting and packing hall with crates of tomatoes and cucumbers
A refrigerated truck being loaded with crates ready for export

about.title: Rooted in the Nile Delta, built for global markets
about.body: Al Fath Green was founded to connect Egyptian farmland directly with importers, without middlemen. We work with a network of partner farms and follow the crop at every stage: variety and seed selection, harvest timing, packing, and refrigerated shipping.
about.body2: What sets us apart isn't the size of a shipment — it's its consistency: the same grade, the same packaging, on the agreed date. Shipment after shipment.
about.videoLabel: A tour through the fields and the packing house
about.videoAlt: The Al Fath Green team inspecting the crop in the field at sunset

services.title: From the field to the port
services.sub: An integrated operation covering every stage of growing and exporting the crop.

items.title: Fruit Harvesting
items.desc: Hand-picked on a schedule set by each variety's season, so the fruit reaches the right ripeness on arrival — not at picking.

items.title: Fruit Sorting & Packing
items.desc: Sorted by size and grade, packed to European import requirements with full labelling and lot identification.

items.title: Global Export
items.desc: Refrigerated sea and air freight with complete customs documentation, tracked through to the destination port.

items.title: Vegetable Harvesting
items.desc: Daily structured picking that follows each variety's growth cycle to protect texture, weight and taste.

items.title: Vegetable Sorting & Packing
items.desc: Automated and manual sorting lines that keep every crate uniform before it enters the cold chain.

items.title: Storage & Preservation
items.desc: Cold stores held at the right temperature for each variety, keeping produce fresh from harvest to loading.

products.title: What Egyptian soil gives
products.sub: A range of fresh fruit and vegetables, available according to the harvest seasons across the year.

certificates.title: Quality isn't a promise — it's a document
certificates.sub: Every shipment we release meets internationally recognised food safety standards.
